`tag_filter_test.ttf` is a small subset of DejaVu Sans, renamed TagFilterTest.
Its narrow Latin glyphs reproduce the tag strip's former overflow oscillation,
which Flutter's uniform Ahem test font does not expose. The fixture is only
loaded by widget tests and is not included in application assets.

Source: https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/
The font's copyright and permission notice are in LICENSE.txt.
